caption: The drawing depicts a single object centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The object is a cage-like structure shaped like a bell or dome, wider at the bottom and narrowing towards the top. The structure consists of multiple evenly spaced, thin horizontal hoops connected by several vertical bands, creating a grid pattern. The hoops and bands are light grey with some yellowish-beige accents. At the top, the horizontal hoops form a small circular opening surrounded by bands, one of which has a series of button or rivet-like markings and a looped end. The entire object is rendered with fine lines and subtle shading, showing details such as joints and fastenings between the hoops and bands. There is a handwritten signature, “N. Acampora,” in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Hoop
